findings.highlight: make her put her mind to it
findings.governingReading: Zouken says he cannot himself induce Sakura into the required state or willingness.
findings.explanation: The English uses an ill-fitting idiom suggesting deliberate concentration.

findings.highlight: I needed Sakura to feel despair in this world
findings.evidenceJa: この世に絶望して貰わねばならなかった
findings.governingReading: Zouken needed Sakura to despair of the world itself.
findings.explanation: The English relocates despair within the world instead of making the world its object.
